title: Sales Category Peak Price Report
subtitle: Identify the highest unit price in each product category and the raw document/party to investigate
ruleSummary: Peak price means the highest calculated unit price within each product category. Unit price = Gross Revenue / Qty. The report lists every raw row tied at the category peak, plus source document and owner for follow-up.
